LanguageData.Gun_M249_RWP.label: M249
LanguageData.Gun_M249_RWP.description: The M249 is a light machine gun designed to provide sustained automatic fire with a high rate of fire and large magazine capacity. Ideal for suppressing enemies or engaging multiple targets, the M249 delivers a balance of firepower and mobility. While it excels in fire rate, its accuracy is moderate, making it most effective at shorter ranges.
